rules.title: Prohibition on selling, licensing, or providing algorithmic devices to landlords
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. An algorithmic device is software or a product that uses algorithms to calculate nonpublic competitor data of two or more landlords and advise or recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in the City of San Diego.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic
rules.exemptions: Per §98.1102, 'algorithmic device' excludes: (a) software or products used to publish reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from public information, that do not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; (b) software or products used to set rental rates or income limits under local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines; (c) software or products used in an appraisal that do not recommend rental rates during runtime operation.
rules.interaction: Companion to the landlord-use prohibition in §98.1103(b). Remedies are in §98.1104.

rules.title: Prohibition on landlord use of algorithmic devices to set rents or occupancy levels
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.quoted_span: (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or
rules.exemptions: Software or products excluded from the 'algorithmic device' definition in §98.1102 (public or aged aggregated data reports without recommendations; affordable housing program rate or income-limit tools; appraisal tools that do not recommend rates at runtime) are not covered.
rules.interaction: Each month of a continuing violation, and each property where a device is used, is a separate violation (see separate rule).

rules.title: Separate violation counted per month and per property for landlord algorithmic device use
rules.requirement: For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property on which a landlord uses an algorithmic device, the violation is a separate and distinct violation.

rules.title: Tenant civil remedies for algorithmic device violations
rules.requirement: A tenant may bring a civil action against a landlord for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation of the Division. A prevailing landlord or tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
